question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**employ**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is “farmers,” which is plural.
 
• Therefore, the verb used should also be in plural form to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• "**employ**" fits correctly because it indicates that farmers are currently using innovative strategies and technologies.
 
• Other options like “employed,” “employs,” and “employing” do not fit grammatically or contextually in the given sentence structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **“Employ” **means to make use of or utilize — appropriate for farmers adopting new methods.
 
• **“Employed”** indicates past action, but the passage uses the present tense contextually.
 
• **“Employs”** is singular and does not agree with the plural subject “farmers.”
 
• **“Employing”** would make the sentence grammatically incomplete.
